verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a REST interface for connecting to MCP servers, token scoping for programmatic/agent access, and a CLI (smithery mcp/tool commands) for driving the platform, which supports agentic use. However, probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable reference, suggesting the public API is documented only in prose form rather than as a full formal API reference. missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec or machine-readable API reference, independent/hands-on corroboration that the REST API works as documented for arbitrary automation.
